out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. There is no “employees must wash hands” sign at the new handsink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. The EHS provided the PIC with a sign during the inspection

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: foods in the Traulsen 2 door upright refrigerator were not being held cold enough. Milk was 44°. Half-and-half is 45°. Liquid eggs were 93°. Hard-boiled eggs are 46º. Shredded cheddar cheese was 49º.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Discard these foods if they have been out of temperature for more than 4 hours. The PIC discarded the foods.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Clean Utensils Storage and Handling
violations.observation: Clean plates and bowls at the continental breakfast buffet were found handled, displayed or dispensed with the food or lip-contact surface facing upward.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items and cleaned/sanitized utensils shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of food and lip contact surfaces are prevented. Invert or cover the bowls and plates at the buffet to protect them from contamination. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: the ambient temperature of the 2-door Traulsen refrigerator was 47º and foods in it were not being held cold enough.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. The PIC moved the food to another unit and will have it adjusted or serviced as soon as possible. Contact your EHS when the unit is repaired and working properly again.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink in the kitchen area being used to dump liquid food waste (coffee) and wash a water pitcher.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. The environmental health specialist (EHS) discussed this with the person in charge (PIC) and the food employee. CDI.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: commercial peeled hard cooked eggs were 50ºF on the buffet. F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Cooked eggs must be held at 41ºF or below on the buffet. The person in charge discarded the eggs.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. Hand soap dispenser was empty- no hand soap at handsink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. Manager provided hand soap.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Observed a bottle of Fantastik stored over single use forks and a container of Bar Keepers stored with seasonings on dry storage rack.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. Removed chemicals from rack.
